text:
maya: Quick oncall FYI — I'll be handing off at 21:30 PT. Rolling out a small model-routing tweak (switch traffic to routing v2 for region-us-west). Expect low risk but please watch latency and error spikes during the canary. Freeze window: 21:25–22:00 PT. Tagging @tony @alex as rollout watchers.

tony: Thanks — are we doing a staged canary? what's the plan to rollback if we see regressions? :eyes:

maya: Yes — canary at 10% for 5min -> 30% for 10min -> 100%. Rollback plan: revert route to routing v1 and reassign canary label, and open PR to revert config. If latency > +200ms p95 or errors > 0.5% uncorrected, rollback immediately.

alex: I'll watch latency dashboards and tail logs. Quick checklist: 
- verify health endpoints: `curl -s https://api.redwood.test/health | jq .status` 
- smoke generate sample prompt via: `python tools/smoke.py --model routing-v2 --region us-west` 
- confirm canary metric set in dashboard (canary_tag = routing-v2)

jamie: added you both to watchlist and set alert: latency_p95_us-west > 200ms for 2m -> pager.

deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled by maya at 21:30 PT. Canary: 10% -> 30% -> 100%. Notifying watchers: tony, alex, jamie.

maya: Leaving a short runbook note in /runbooks/oncall/routing-v2-canary.md. If you get paged, first step is to pause rollout: `infra rollback-route routing v1` (ops only).

tony: copying that. I'll be on-call through 23:00 PT in case we need to roll back. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Canary started at 21:31 PT. Initial health checks pass. Telemetry: p95=120ms, errors=0.08%.

alex: saw a small spike to 180ms at 21:33 but settled. continuing to monitor. smoke tests ok.

deploy-bot: Canary promoted to 30% at 21:37 PT. Health checks stable.

maya: Thanks all — I'm offline now. Ping oncall if anything goes sideways. Leaving my number in the runbook.

jamie: noted. I'll keep watching through 22:00 and unwatch after full promotion.

deploy-bot: Promotion to 100% completed at 21:48 PT. Final checks p95=125ms, errors=0.1%.

tony: all good on my side. marking this as no-regressions. :white_check_mark:

alex: closing monitoring loop, will file a brief post-deploy note in the releases doc tomorrow with perf numbers.

maya: appreciate the coverage, team. :heart:
